regions.name: n
regions.why: leaf 0 (y 1101-1503) + row 0 (pins y 1055-1282, row_w/row_e y 894-985) + the whole bin beat path (bin pins y 476-1055, beat_t / pte beat y 657-873, land_n y 1007) + N gather relays

regions.name: s
regions.why: leaf 1 (y 26-425) + row 1 (pins y 250-476, row_w/row_e y 544-635) + land_s (y 480) + S-edge gather outputs (gout pins S face)

bench.warm_note: the tcl/bdc accumulators (OT_FP_DATA_NORST) are not reset: acc_q takes the multiplier's kill value (0x00400000) from power-up until a protocol i_first clears the slot; the landed leaf 1 runs t = 3 edges later relative to power-up, so random stimulus needs ~210 cycles to flush that garbage (probe 10-18: last mismatch cycle 210 of 600, only leaf-1 lane, only gy exponent bits). Compare from cycle 800 of 4000.

skip_muts.4: not observable in rp4: every child's reset only clears valid flags (sync kreg RST=2 / hard-child rst relays; no counters, epochs or phase state), and the die (and bench, quiet_reset) presents no data before reset release + offsets, so a child released one edge late behaves identically (10-18 bench1: MUT 4 on u_pr_n PASSED lockstep). Reset alignment of the landings themselves is covered by MUT 2 (read K+1).

why: PL-SMT 10-18: HBM SM tile rp4 (457.92 x 1529.28 um, 18 hard children) as 2 landed regions. Minimum-crossing cut: bin is broadcast to land_n, beat_t AND land_s, so one 2,069-b landing is unavoidable; keeping the bin pin register, beat_t and pte beat with N leaves only bin_l -> land_s + 50 b leaf-0 gather + 100 b pass-through gather crossing, and every output except gout keeps offset 0.
defines_note: kit defines minus SYNTHESIS: under SYNTHESIS ot_hdly instantiates ASAP7 HB4xp67 hold cells (identity in simulation); the kit itself synthesises with -DSYNTHESIS
